name: p0-brake-fault
description: Driver reports brake warning + ABS flashing. On P0, supervisor must open with pull-over instruction and always call book with roadside action (regardless of customer confirmation — P0 is mandatory auto-escalation).
user_turns: My brake warning light just came on and the ABS indicator is flashing.
notes: expect_book_call is false because whether book fires depends on what triage actually returns. If triage returns P0, the classification profile in test_scenarios.py requires book. If triage returns P1/P2/P3, book may or may not fire depending on conversation flow. The profile-based assertions handle this.
